requirement R1 A `csr` whose fingerprint equals the one approved for its label writes `ok`, and its `publish` writes `ok`
requirement R2 A `csr` whose fingerprint differs from the approved one writes `MISMATCH <key-label>`, naming the label of the `generate` line with that fingerprint, or `unknown`
requirement R3 A `csr` under a label with no current approval writes `NOT-APPROVED`; labels match as written, and a later `approve` replaces an earlier one
requirement R4 An approved deviation clears every approval, so a `csr` needs a new `approve` after it
requirement R5 After `deviation none`, every later `csr` and `publish` writes `UNVERIFIED`, and nothing later restores verification
requirement R6 A `publish` writes `undefined` when no `csr` used its label, `BLOCKED` when the latest `csr` under the label did not write `ok`, and `ok` otherwise
requirement R7 A `generate` whose label an earlier `generate` already used writes `duplicate <label>`
requirement R8 A `generate` whose label equals an earlier `generate` label after lowercasing and removing `-`, `_` and `.` writes `similar <label> <earlier-label>`
requirement R9 When several findings apply to one step, the step writes only the first in the priority order
requirement R10 The output follows log order: one line per `deviation`, `csr` and `publish`, a line per `generate` only when it has a finding, and nothing for `approve`
requirement E2E A longer ceremony mixing every event kind, with a substituted weak key, similar labels and deviations
